    • calculateUCT

      public double calculateUCT(double explorationConst, double[] globalMinMargins, double[] globalMaxMargins, int parentActivePlayerIndex)
      Calculates the Upper Confidence Bound applied to Trees (UCT) value.

      UCT = normalised_exploitation + C * sqrt(ln(timesAvailable) / timesExplored)

      Exploitation is the average margin for the active player, normalised to [0, 1] using the global min/max bounds tracked by the tree.

      Specified by:
      calculateUCT in class BaseSearchNode<IsmctsNode>
      Parameters:
      explorationConst - weight for the exploration term
      globalMinMargins - per-player running minimum of all simulation margins
      globalMaxMargins - per-player running maximum of all simulation margins
      parentActivePlayerIndex - ordinal of the player to move at the parent node
      Returns:
      the computed UCT score
